standard_prerequisites: Chapter lemma-trace-and-norm-linear (source lemma, worklist row 20): for a finite-dimensional L-vector space V and an L-linear map phi, Trace_K(phi) = Trace_(L/K)(Trace_L(phi)) and det_K(phi) = Norm_(L/K)(det_L(phi))
Chapter definitions: the trace and norm of an element alpha in M over L are the trace and determinant of the L-linear multiplication map m_alpha on M
core_obligations: View M as a vector space over L and apply the linear lemma to the L-linear map m_alpha for each alpha in M

Elementwise: Trace_(M/K)(alpha) = Trace_K(m_alpha) = Trace_(L/K)(Trace_L(m_alpha)) = Trace_(L/K)(Trace_(M/L)(alpha)); the norm identity is the determinant half of the same lemma with det_L(m_alpha) = Norm_(M/L)(alpha)
proof_roadmap: Feed the multiplication map into the linear trace-determinant lemma
Read the elementwise tower identities off the definitions
